classification.difficultyReason: Students build the exponential graph, use a horizontal intersection, then rearrange the final equation to match the plotted expression with y=x-1.5 and read both solutions.

content.prompt: The table shows some values for $y=2^x-3$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: On the grid, sketch the graph $y=2^x-3$ for $-2\leq x\leq2.5$.

spec.description: Editable drawing axes extracted from the supplied answer graph; no grid lines or tick strokes are visible in the source.
spec.mathematics: Horizontal labels -2,-1,0,1,2; vertical labels -3,-2,-1,1,2,3. Unit coordinate scale on both axes.
spec.answerVisibility: Axes and numeric labels only; completed exponential curve is answer-only.

answer.short: Increasing, concave-up curve through $(0,-2)$, from $(-2,-2.75)$ to $(2.5,2.66)$ approximately.
answer.worked: Plot the table values and join them with a smooth increasing curve over $-2\leq x\leq2.5$.

spec.description: Equation-driven exponential sketch with source axis labels and arrowheads at both curve ends. Ordinary axes and labels use house black.
spec.mathematics: y=2^x-3, -2<=x<=2.5; y-intercept -2, x-intercept log_2(3). No grid, plotted point markers or asymptote line.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Use your graph to solve $2^x-3=2$. Give your estimate to 1 decimal place.

answer.worked: Draw the horizontal line $y=2$ on the graph from part b. Read the $x$-coordinate of its intersection with the curve: $x\approx2.3$.

spec.description: Complete answer graph showing the requested horizontal construction and a vertical reading guide.
spec.mathematics: Intersection of y=2^x-3 and y=2 at x=log_2(5), approximately 2.3.

children.label: d
children.prompt: By drawing a suitable straight line, solve $2^x-x-1.5=0$. Give any non-exact estimate to 2 decimal places.

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}2^x-x-1.5&=0\\2^x-3&=x-1.5\end{align*}$$ Draw $y=x-1.5$ on the graph from part b. Read the $x$-coordinates of the two intersections: $x=-1$ and $x\approx1.66$.

spec.description: Complete answer graph with the suitable straight line and guides to both intersection abscissae.
spec.mathematics: y=2^x-3 and y=x-1.5 intersect at (-1,-2.5) and approximately (1.66218,0.16218).
